23.name: Glacier Lake
23.why: Meltwater over pale rock makes lakes this steady mid-teal, and the name stays out of the way.

23.name: Tidewater
23.why: The water where the tide turns, clear and steady in this same mid-teal.

23.name: Meltwater
23.why: The melt in my furnace and the cold snowmelt running down through Tbilisi, one teal to me.

24.name: Morning Mist
24.why: The first hour over the water, before the color has fully arrived.

24.name: Breaker Foam
24.why: The lace at a wave's edge, a shade lighter than the water beneath it.

24.name: Cold Glass
24.why: The faint tint of thin glass held to the light before a piece leaves the bench.
